subject.title: fix(ui): keep sidebar session titles aligned

question: Should the Control UI sidebar permanently surface open/merged pull-request state and poll the gateway for each visible worktree row every 60 seconds as part of this alignment fix?
rationale: The fixed-slot layout addresses the reported visual jump, while PR-state presentation and periodic polling add a broader user-facing behavior that is not established by the alignment problem alone.

options.title: Approve the combined sidebar state
options.body: Keep the PR-state indicator after the contributor supplies redacted live UI and gateway diagnostics showing the intended refresh and rate-limit behavior.

options.title: Narrow to alignment only
options.body: Retain the neutral fixed leading slot and existing transient indicators, but remove PR polling and PR-state decoration from this PR.

recommendation.title: Approve the combined sidebar state
recommendation.body: Keep the PR-state indicator after the contributor supplies redacted live UI and gateway diagnostics showing the intended refresh and rate-limit behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context identifies steipete with the proposed UI and gateway integration; repository history could not be inspected to identify a stronger current-main owner.
